responsibility: Converts query-produced and closure-instantiated outlives constraints into MIR borrowck region data structures by translating region predicates into outlives edges, member constraints, placeholder regions, and type tests recorded in `MirTypeckRegionConstraints`. It is especially relevant to closure outlives requirements and NLL type tests, where query constraints must be converted into `TypeTest` subjects and closure requirement data. Bugs here can make an opaque or closure-related type test use the wrong subject or region, causing a returned `impl Trait` or closure requirement to be rejected as not living long enough.
